en: Stylized Art Nouveau / early modernist illustration of a bird resembling a peacock, rendered in flat black and blue shapes on a cream background. The bird has a fan of long thin tail feathers ending in small floral shapes and vertical blue-and-black stripes on its body. The design is minimal and graphic, with the artist's signature at the lower right and a museum or collection credit strip along the bottom.
